limitations: No new orders in the observation window; not end-to-end live order acceptance.
Database waits checked at baseline, midpoint and final audit, not continuously.
No profiler; five-second cgroup samples establish correlation, not exact peak causation.
Readonly audits and Docker inspection add some observer overhead; reported collector CPU excludes child processes.
Prior release observation used a different time and load, not a controlled performance A/B.
Ten minutes cannot establish absence of long-term memory leaks.
